text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(My dream is
to become the "me in that dream.")

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Winning more GⅠs than any Umamusume before,
being constantly called a genius, seizing crowns nobody had ever claimed before—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Super awesome and invincible me!
The sparkling me that I'm definitely gonna become one day!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Someday, absolutely, definitely, without a doubt!
—And when I do, you'll be happy too, right?!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aim for the me of my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps spurred by the bitter frustration of the Oka Sho, Fusaichi Pandora showed even further transformation as she headed toward the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Mornin'♡
I'm already done stretchin', so I'm ready to run~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her approach to training became even more serious.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew, today was exhausting too!
...But! Maybe I'll run a little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She started doing independent training...
And on top of that, she even said something like this!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And to win lots of GⅠs... Oh, I know!
Shouldn't I be able to beat senior runners who've won tons of GⅠs?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, set up a mock race for me!
Gather lots of strong seniors who've won tons of GⅠs!
choice_data_list: I see! Alright, who do you have in mind?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh, like the Student Council President! Or Opera O-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, legendary Umamusume of such caliber
that they were said to have defined an era, like Symboli Rudolf and—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation, Fusaichi Pandora.
I shall bear witness to your unwavering resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Another legendary Umamusume who made the impossible possible with the sheer strength of an Overlord: T.M. Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You wish to experience my grand finale up close, do you not?
I shall prepare the best seat in the house for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We enlisted the help of these powerhouse Umamusume
and held a practice race!
choice_data_list: (To be honest, the gap in our abilities is immense. But still!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to brush aside her enthusiasm.
Above all, it's bound to be a great source of motivation!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!!
Nothing less than 1st place is acceptable, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
14th plaaace~!?
No waaaay~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Even me! After doing all that?!
I did terrible! Why, why...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, today's race was against top-tier contenders.
Placing in the top five was considered next to a miracle, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And here I thought I could win!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Because this genius here worked super hard! So of course you'd think we got this in the bag!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And yet, ugh, this is totally useless!
When am I ever gonna start racking up GⅠ wins!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ugggh, it's hopeless! *deflates*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I'd sensed it even before her debut,
but Fusaichi Pandora's expectations of herself
are indeed a little detached from reality."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, as long as she takes it one step at a time,
I know she can achieve her ideals someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She needs to understand that.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Mom and Dad!?
No way! But why are they here!?

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Your Trainer came all the way to my place this morning,
asking if I would meet with you!"

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text: You're homesick? I bought Pan-chan's favorite snacks, so you go right ahead and let your papas pamper you today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I called Fusaichi Pandora's parents.
She gets along extremely well with them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they could deliver the words
that I cannot reach with on my own.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, wha, wha...!
choice_data_list: This might come as a surprise so suddenly, but I'd really like to talk—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aww, geez, listen to this, Papa, Mamaaa~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ugh, it was seriously so tough! Like, the President and Opera O-senpai are way too strong~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, when will my dream even come true...
Ugh, seriously... I'm so totally bummed..."

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, Pan-chan has been working so hard, what a good girl.
You've been shouldering so much all on your own, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I'm not alone.
See, Trainer is here too.

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right.
I've got a dependable Trainer by my side."

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text: "Even if Pan-chan feels like she can't go on, Trainer-san will support me. That's why Pan-chan can keep moving forward!"

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing all that, that's what Papa thought.
Isn't that right, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dream is to "win lots of GⅠ races and sparkle."
As long as we advance steadily step by step,
it's by no means an impossible dream.
choice_data_list: We can take our time—let's make that dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...
Yeah, guess so.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I was just rushing things too much.
I kinda lost heart after that practice race against stronger opponents."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……I'm okay now!
Thank you, Trainer. ……Dad, Mom!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for having me today!
Pan-chan, stay healthy and do your best!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thanks for today, you two.

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing. Anything for my beloved Pan-chan
is a piece of cake.

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Mother
text_block_list.text: That's right. We could even fly to the other side of the world.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Papa, Mama...? Do you really think I can win?

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
We can definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha, you're so right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Rhein Kraft has announced that
she will be taking a temporary leave from
the Twinkle Series to recuperate."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wait-wait-wait-wait-wait-wait-wait,
Kuu-chan-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Why?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —It's really no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's just that, since the Victoria Mile the other day,
my body's been feeling a little heavy.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So I went for a detailed checkup just to be safe, and they said I should focus on resting for a while.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: N-No way...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm alright!
The doctor told me I'll be fine as long as I rest up properly.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make my comeback this fall!
So look out for me in the Senior year,
Pandora-san!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
......
......Liar. Your face was totally pale.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I hate this...
I hate the idea of retiring like this.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Like, to think the day would come
when Kuu-chan-senpai won't be
in the Twinkle Series anymore...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Something like that... I'd never
even thought about it until now.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Even though it's bound to happen anyway.
Even so—I mean, isn't that true for me too?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (It's not like I can keep running forever, right...?)

text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text: FUSAICHI PAAAANDOOORAAA!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Pandora! Pandora!
Pandora! Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (I want to properly make my dream come true before it ends.)

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
We can definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I want to finish this...
after truly living up to their expectations.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (I knew it, I need to hurry and move forward.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mornin', Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, when I arrived at the Trainer's Room for work,
Fusaichi Pandora was waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I know I said taking it slow was fine the other day,
but I really wanna dash toward my dream as fast as I can!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it my all at the Oaks, for real...
and go full throttle to win GⅠs one after another!"
choice_data_list: W-What's got into you all of a sudden?!
W-What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, come on.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series is gonna end someday anyway, and one day I won't be able to run anymore either, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And... with everyone being as strong as the President, it's not like I can keep winning forever, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then shouldn't we hurry as fast as we can?
I wanna make my dream come true for real before it ends!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to make it come true. I want to show them and make them proud.
For Mom and Dad, who have always believed in me."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
For Kuu-chan-senpai's sake too,
since she always pretends she's fine even when it's tough.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...For your sake, too, after everything you've done for me.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm a genius, so this is easy-peasy. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder if Rhein Kraft has something to do with this after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's true that there's an unavoidable time limit. I can no longer irresponsibly tell you not to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
!
Yeah! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Winning GⅠ races sooner, and winning more of them.
—Starting with the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks).
That was the promise we renewed."
